message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In `Expand.extractFile`, the untrusted `entryName` from `ZipEntry.getName()` is passed to `FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName)` to produce `File f`, but there is no containment check ensuring that the resolved `f` stays under destination directory `dir` (e.g., no canonical-path prefix check or rejection of `..` traversal). The unchecked `f` is then passed directly to `new FileOutputStream(f)`, allowing a malicious zip entry name to write outside the intended extraction directory."}]}
